m24_historical_summary_before_completion.claim_zh: 活动后果参与重建选择该组织的条件，使其经具体承载者变化仍能接续；区分机制条件、实际边界、动力学接近及可行纠正。 新会话进一步检验精确局部目标执行怎样经制度后果进入共同损失；局部安全与共同执行保护分列。 Ren 后续提出复杂性增长与实际认知／行动能力失配的退化候选；区别需求、回应、损失与修复。 条件接续已证明逐前缀支持与内生回应受损，并保留可负担恢复及需求调整。 可纠正性接续区分实际回应能力与接受目的修订的动机。 纠正依存模型接通退出负担、真实请求、后继配合及共同支持。 实际担保与检查结算可在明确条件下把有代价纠正变为最优选择。 当前方向依 Ren 纠正为共同组织中的调节形成、分化整合与持续修订；不以利益对立或监管不可靠为一般起点。 共同探究可修订问题表述与目的，当前检验是新根据怎样进入正在执行的共同任务。 9日局部组合已把取得的目的修订接入在途任务，保留传递依存并使端点行动执行改变后的实践。 作用前的付费复查现已接入实际送达任务；按实际相关条件支持接续，并区分行动保护与原比较理由的持续成立。 13日 P93 接通登记关系自身修订：保留全部旧选择恰当新登记不合并旧差异；同一局部控制过程重构观察、补充支持并实际改变回应。 P99 进一步接通取得的失配→下一参考接触计划→新取得并检查的装置→后续回应：两次方法修订同处一个不重置支持的实际历史，已安装的新接触带来此前不能表达的选择。
m24_historical_summary_before_completion.claim_en: Consequences help reproduce conditions selecting an organization across carrier changes; distinguish mechanism conditions, formed boundaries, dynamical approach and feasible correction. A new session tests how exact local objective fidelity can lead through institutional consequences to collective loss; local safety and joint-execution protection remain distinct. Ren subsequently proposes degeneration through a mismatch between growing complexity and effective cognition/action; demand, response, loss and repair remain distinct. The conditional continuation now proves prefix support and endogenous response impairment, retaining affordable recovery and demand adjustment. The corrigibility assessment distinguishes effective response from willingness to revise ends. Correction dependence connects exit burdens, truthful requests, successor cooperation and shared provision. Actual stake posting and audit settlement can make costly correction optimal under explicit conditions. Ren’s current correction makes regulatory formation, differentiation, integration and continuing revision within common organization the next focus, without presupposing opposed interests or untrustworthy supervision. Joint inquiry can revise problem formulations and purposes; the current test is how revised grounds enter a shared task already underway. The 9 October local composition now joins acquired goal revision to a pending task, retaining delivery dependencies while changing the enacted practice. Paid pre-effect review now consumes the actually delivered task, supporting continuation under relevant conditions while separating action protection from continued comparative warrant. On 13 October P93 joins revision of registration itself: all old choices survive exactly when new registration merges no old distinction; one local controlled process reconstructs observation, restores support and actually changes response. P99 further joins acquired mismatch to the next reference-contact plan, fresh checked apparatus and later response: two method revisions share one actual history without resetting support, and newly installed contacts enable previously unavailable selections.
m24_historical_summary_before_completion.scope_zh: 原47／65、承载者40／69、再生58／107、判准34／56、检验改组43／87、干预发现另43／87各轮定理／审计保留。拓展探究新增54项 Lean 定理／99项审计：材料制造与安装扩大干预深度，预留解除中断及恢复能力，接通任意有限轮次、范围内故障认证与实际回应。每一有限隐藏合并可由继续拓展揭示，但有限效果记录不能自证无限分离。稳定嵌套依存、构造与供给、实际送达及记录忠实仍为前提；范围内实践认证不以全知为门槛。不宣称普遍层级、完整理论或独立验收。1,024项网络探索不计作证明。 当前旧数学校正与共同组织接通新增41项定理／89项新审计、112项继承定理审计：同一付费历史从形成接到调节、失败留痕、更新机制取得与再次修订。保留擦除记录及缺乏支持的失败；桥接、感测装置、候选范围及事件安排仍给定。下一连接是这些关系在持续活动中的形成与修订；新联合模型未证明渐近吸引。 集体破坏第一构造另有32项新定理／41项审计，检查两位置阶段最优化、正且可增长吞吐下的有限到达、精确盆地及严格保护；平局失败与无法自动恢复保留。接续新增71项定理／100项审计，接通有限人口替换、内部筹资、恢复／耗尽精确分界及材料约束下的核心接续；恢复前归零、分流与缺件失败保留。到墙范围是实际征收、证据、权限与承诺的形成和维护，未宣称普遍收敛或经验对应。 新的普遍连接与当前社会诊断仍为候选，已有证明不冒充指数复杂性或必然崩溃的证明。 回应接续新增46项定理／53项审计，涵盖明确指数需求／线性回应特例和所有可负担当期留存支持最优策略的失败；认识的实际形成及社会对应仍开放。 Corrigibility 概念整合无新增证明；规范理由、执行协议与局部维持不构成完整解决。 再增38项定理／61项审计：服从下的依存固化、原任务全部最优方案的损害、受约束的有代价纠正与共同退出分界；动机、真实负担与正当权限仍须解释。 承诺接续再增35项定理／47项审计，检查全部最优方案、实际关闭、区分度与有限资源界限；误罚、近似选择、参与及串通反例保留，内在关切和监管自身形成未证。 此次非二元方向纠正不新增证明；中枢整合、合作下失败及关系改组须进入后续比较，博弈与担保结果须有局部对应，既有完成范围不变。 共同问题接续复用目的修订及变化中传达的既有结果；新组合未证，供水情境为示例，Ostrom 指定段落为有限来源比较。 新增一项组合成果（17项定理声明／27项审计），188项导入定理／327项审计分列；二元转译、同步改写及权限明示，根据过期、仅改标签和支持不足失败保留。共同目的的开放形成与工作中持续适用未证。 适用性接续新增14项定理／22项审计，205项继承定理／354项继承审计分列；在给定作用规律下允许无关处境字段变化，保留复查耗尽行动支持及报告不覆盖作用的失败。缺少根据或支持时保留未完成任务，不把等待当成安全；相关性取得、报告形成与真实需求接续仍待说明。 P93 新增25项定理／35项源声明审计，公理报告全空；主干与外围兼容实查通过。形成区分却耗尽执行支持、支持尚存却关闭区分的反例保留。真实记忆、固定重建偏好与配方自身取得、开放候选及同材料历史组合仍未推出；既有形成结果不重做，未新增吸引盆地。 接续复核信用已成 CalibrationRenewal 的实际校准与后续修复：可表达选择、正确对应及实际执行分列；未把这些旧成果重复计为 P93 新贡献。 P99 最终新增43项定理／68项源声明审计，公理报告全空；核心及外围兼容实际通过。上文所留局部参考计划接口现已完成，旧结果未重新计数。冻结第二次方法保留第一次修复及更多支持却仍失败；擦除、耗尽、不可分离参考及检查后漂移仍失败。接触原语、可靠回返、绑定、二值／稳定对应及修订律仍给定；任意感知发明、所有旧材料模型的形式拼接、通用吸引和规范根据未由此完成。 最终漂移对照含同一过程内有消耗的改变及后续失败，不仅改写起始配置；参考登记限定为已安装接触，活动回返的另一路实际关系仍保留。首轮42定理检查作为历史保存。 P103 完成原任务的理论整合：直接复用 P99，从空参考装置形成实际使用，再以成功生产回返支承承载更替和下一方法修订；新增36定理／62源声明空公理报告，实际无限 Run 与累计支持账已检查。冻结、断供、储备耗尽及旧区分退役保留失败和真实损失；旧公式按校正表处理，不由持续性推出普遍吸引、经验对应或规范根据。
m24_historical_summary_before_completion.scope_en: Earlier theorem/audit packages 47/65, carrier 40/69, reproduction 58/107, admission 34/56, testing reorganization 43/87 and separate discovery 43/87 retain their scopes. Expanding inquiry adds 54 theorems/99 audits: material fabrication and installation deepen access, reserved restoration keeps interrupted inquiry executable, and arbitrary finite rounds join covered-fault certification to actual response. Each finite hidden merger is exposed by continued expansion, but finite effect records cannot certify unrestricted separation. Stable nested dependence, construction, supply, delivery and faithful records remain premises; bounded practical warrant does not require omniscience. No universal hierarchy, complete theory or independent acceptance is claimed. The 1,024 network explorations are not proofs. Current reconciliation and common organization add 41 theorems/89 new audits, with 112 inherited theorem audits: one paid history joins formation, regulation, retained failure, acquired updater choice and further revision. Erased records and insufficient support retain genuine failures; the bridge, sensing recipe, repertoire and schedule remain supplied. Their formation and revision during continuing activity is the next connection; no asymptotic attraction is proved for the new joint model. A separate first collective-destruction construction adds 32 theorems / 41 audits for two-position stage optimization, finite arrival under positive and possibly growing throughput, an exact basin and strict protection, retaining tie failure and absent automatic recovery. The continuation adds 71 theorems / 100 audits for bounded population replacement, internally financed correction, exact recovery/destruction boundaries and material-guarded core histories. Interim loss, diversion and missing-parts failures remain. The wall is formation and preservation of actual collection, evidence, authority and commitments; universal convergence and empirical correspondence are not established. The broader implication and diagnosis of current society remain hypotheses; existing proofs establish neither exponential societal complexity nor inevitable collapse. The response continuation adds 46 theorems / 53 audits, including a specified exponential-demand/linear-response case and failure of all affordable immediate-support-optimal policies. Actual cognitive realization and societal correspondence remain open. The conceptual corrigibility integration adds no proof; normative reasons, execution protocols and local maintenance do not constitute a full solution. A further 38 theorems / 61 audits cover entrenchment despite obedience, harmful unrestricted task optima, costly constrained correction and joint exit capacity; motivation, actual burdens and legitimate authority remain explicit obligations. The commitment continuation adds 35 theorems / 47 audits for all optimizing plans, actual shutdown, discrimination and finite-resource bounds; false positives, approximate choice, participation and collusion remain, without deriving intrinsic concern or oversight formation. This nondual direction correction adds no proof: integrated regulation, cooperative failure and relational reorganization enter the next comparison; strategic and stake models require local correspondence, with completed scopes unchanged. The joint-problem continuation reuses completed purpose-revision and changing-delivery results; their new composition remains unproved, the water example is illustrative, and selected Ostrom passages supply a bounded source comparison. One new composition result (17 theorem declarations/27 audits) is separated from 188 imported theorems/327 audits. Binary translation, synchronous rewrite and authority are explicit; stale grounds, relabeling and insufficient support failures remain. Open joint-purpose formation and continuing applicability during work are unproved. The applicability continuation adds 14 theorems/22 audits, separately from 205 inherited theorems/354 audits. The supplied outcome law admits changes to irrelevant context fields, retaining review-induced action exhaustion and reports failing to cover the effect. Missing grounds or support retain an unfinished task without certifying waiting safe; relevance acquisition, report formation and actual continuation of needs remain open. P93 adds 25 theorems/35 source-declaration audits, all axiom-free, with passed core and peripheral compatibility checks. It retains the cases of gaining discrimination while exhausting execution support, and closing discrimination despite remaining stock. Actual memory, acquisition of the fixed reconstruction preference and recipe, open candidates and the same-material-history composition remain unproved; earlier formation results are reused, and no attraction basin is added. Follow-up review credits the completed actual recalibration and later repair in CalibrationRenewal: expressibility, warranted correspondence and execution remain distinct, and those older results are not counted again as P93 contributions. P99 finally adds 43 theorems/68 source-declaration audits, all axiom-free, with actual core and peripheral checks passed. The preceding local reference-plan interface is now complete; prior results are not counted again. Freezing the second method retains the first repair and more support yet still fails; erasure, exhaustion, inseparable references and post-check drift preserve failures. Contact primitives, faithful return, binding, Boolean/stable correspondence and the revision rule remain supplied. Unrestricted sensing invention, formal concatenation of all older material models, general attraction and normative warrant remain unmet by this result. The final drift control includes a charged change and subsequent failure in the same process, rather than only a changed starting configuration. Reference registration concerns installed contacts, with ordinary return retained as another actual relationship. The initial 42-theorem checkpoint remains historical evidence. P103 completes the original theoretical integration: direct P99 reuse forms an apparatus from empty retention, then earned productive return supports succession and the next method revision. Thirty-six new theorems and 62 source declarations have empty axiom reports, with an actual infinite Run and cumulative ledgers. Frozen methods, cut return, reserve exhaustion and retired distinctions retain failures and losses. Historical formulas follow the correction ledger; recurrence does not supply universal attraction, empirical correspondence or normative warrant.
